summary: FD_TC_226_3rd Party � Parent Claiming for Minor (UMNR) � OTP Passed � Automated
title: 3rd Party � Parent Claiming for Minor (UMNR) � OTP Passed � Automated
description:
Validates that when a parent claims on behalf of a minor/UMNR (Unaccompanied Minor) and passes OTP authentication, the claim is processed through the automated flow.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Parent. Passenger is a minor/UMNR. OTP authentication passes.
